proposal.reason: Primary is **kernels**: `src/collectives/device/*.h` rewrites collective device algorithms/primitives to NCCL-style `Primitives`+`Fan` contracts, removes hand-maintained `.cu` instantiations, and adds generator-owned dispatch (`src/collectives/device/generate.py`, generated table plumbing in `src/include/collectives.h`/`src/include/devcomm.h`). Secondary is **kernel-plugin**: ext-kernel ABI is versioned to v2 (`ext-kernel/pccl/ext_kernel.h`, `src/include/ext_kernel_plugin.h`, `ext-kernel/src/plugin.c`), changing plugin symbol, task struct, and device redop contract (`MinMax` fold + scalar args), which is an independent plugin-interface change. Additional **enqueue**: `src/enqueue.cc` switches runtime kernel lookup to generated func-id maps and changes host-to-device redop encoding (`ncclDevMinMax`, signed avg divisor encoding), impacting enqueue/dispatch behavior.
